cards.ex: She's thinking about throwing her hat in the ring for mayor.
cards.exUz: U shahar hokimi lavozimiga o'z nomzodini qo'ymoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Saylovda ishtirok etish uchun o'z nomzodini ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: He decided to run for office because he wants to make a difference.
cards.exUz: U o'zgartirishlar kiritmoqchi bo'lgani uchun saylovda qatnashishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Davlat lavozimini egallash uchun saylovda ishtirok etmoq.

cards.ex: The political landscape has changed dramatically in recent years.
cards.exUz: So'nggi yillarda siyosiy vaziyat keskin o'zgardi.
cards.uzDef: Mamlakatdagi siyosiy partiyalar va g'oyalarning umumiy holati.

cards.ex: The campaign started as a grassroots movement.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya xalq harakati sifatida boshlandi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiy odamlar tomonidan tashkil etilgan siyosiy harakat.

cards.ex: I'm still on the fence about who to vote for.
cards.exUz: Men kimga ovoz berish haqida hali ham ikki o't orasidaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida qaror qabul qila olmaslik.

cards.ex: He had to toe the line to keep his job in the government.
cards.exUz: Hukumatdagi ishini saqlab qolish uchun u yo'l-yo'riqqa amal qilishi kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Guruhning qoidalariga yoki siyosatiga qat'iy rioya qilmoq.

cards.ex: The politician was accused of flip-flopping on the issue.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchi bu masala bo'yicha fikrini o'zgartirganlikda ayblangan.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgi fikriga zid bo'lgan yangi fikrni bildirish.

cards.ex: The candidate is trying to rally support for his new policy.
cards.exUz: Nomzod o'zining yangi siyosatini qo'llab-quvvatlovchilarni yig'ishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror g'oya yoki shaxsni qo'llab-quvvatlovchilarni yig'moq.

cards.ex: The candidate won by a landslide, receiving over 70% of the vote.
cards.exUz: Nomzod ovozlarning 70% dan ortig'ini olib, katta farq bilan g'alaba qozondi.
cards.uzDef: Saylovda juda katta farq bilan g'alaba qozonmoq.

cards.ex: We need to raise awareness about climate change.
cards.exUz: Biz iqlim o'zgarishi haqida xabardorlikni oshirishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror muammo haqida odamlarning bilimini oshirishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: A lot of negotiation happened behind the scenes.
cards.exUz: Ko'p muzokaralar sahna ortida bo'lib o'tdi.
cards.uzDef: Ommadan yashirincha amalga oshiriladigan harakatlar.

cards.ex: The military coup was seen as a blatant power grab.
cards.exUz: Harbiy to'ntarish hokimiyatni ochiqdan-ochiq egallash sifatida ko'rildi.
cards.uzDef: Hokimiyatni noqonuniy yoki adolatsiz yo'l bilan qo'lga kiritishga urinish.

cards.ex: We need to create a level playing field for all businesses.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha bizneslar uchun teng sharoitlar yaratishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar yaratish.

cards.ex: Opposition parties are calling for the president's resignation.
cards.exUz: Muxolifat partiyalari prezidentning iste'fosini talab qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini o'z lavozimidan ketishini talab qilmoq.

cards.ex: Don't believe everything you hear; it's probably just political spin.
cards.exUz: Eshitgan hamma narsaga ishonmang; ehtimol, bu shunchaki siyosiy talqin.
cards.uzDef: Biror voqeani o'z foydasiga talqin qilish.

cards.ex: The campaign is working hard to get out the vote.
cards.exUz: Kampaniya odamlarni ovoz berishga undash uchun qattiq ishlamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Odamlarni saylovda qatnashishga rag'batlantirish.

cards.ex: The politician's sound bite was repeated on the news all day.
cards.exUz: Siyosatchining qisqa iqtibosi kun bo'yi yangiliklarda takrorlandi.
cards.uzDef: Nutqdan olingan qisqa va esda qolarli ibora.

cards.ex: The ruling party is facing a tough election.
cards.exUz: Hukmron partiya qiyin saylovga duch kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi vaqtda hokimiyatda bo'lgan siyosiy partiya.

cards.ex: We need to cut through the red tape to get things done.
cards.exUz: Ishlarni bajarish uchun biz byurokratiyani bartaraf etishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz qoidalar va tartiblar.

cards.ex: The agreement was criticized as a backroom deal.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv yashirin kelishuv sifatida tanqid qilindi.
cards.uzDef: Ommadan yashirincha tuzilgan kelishuv.

cards.ex: He used his political capital to pass the new law.
cards.exUz: U yangi qonunni qabul qilish uchun o'zining siyosiy resursidan foydalandi.
cards.uzDef: Siyosatchining ta'sir o'tkazish qobiliyati.

cards.ex: The union is playing hardball in the negotiations.
cards.exUz: Kasaba uyushmasi muzokaralarda qattiq kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Maqsadga erishish uchun qattiq va murosasiz harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The issue of immigration is a hot potato for politicians.
cards.exUz: Immigratsiya masalasi siyosatchilar uchun dolzarb masala.
cards.uzDef: Bahsli va qiyin masala.

cards.ex: She's been on the campaign trail for months.
cards.exUz: U bir necha oydan beri saylovoldi tashviqotida yuribdi.
cards.uzDef: Saylovoldi tashviqot safari paytida.

cards.ex: He's been a public servant for over 20 years.
cards.exUz: U 20 yildan ortiq vaqtdan beri davlat xizmatchisi.
cards.uzDef: Davlat uchun ishlaydigan odam.

cards.ex: We need to use taxpayer money wisely.
cards.exUz: Biz soliq to'lovchilar pulidan oqilona foydalanishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Soliq to'lovchilar to'lagan pul.

cards.ex: The government announced a new economic stimulus package.
cards.exUz: Hukumat yangi iqtisodiy rag'bat paketini e'lon qildi.
cards.uzDef: Iqtisodiyotni rivojlantirish uchun hukumat tomonidan amalga oshiriladigan chora-tadbirlar.

cards.ex: The government promised to restore law and order.
cards.exUz: Hukumat qonun va tartibni tiklashga va'da berdi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatda qonunlarga rioya qilish va tartibni saqlash.

cards.ex: She stepped into the voting booth to cast her ballot.
cards.exUz: U ovoz berish uchun ovoz berish kabinasiga kirdi.
cards.uzDef: Ovoz berish paytida maxfiylikni ta'minlash uchun kabina.

cards.ex: The current political climate is very tense.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi siyosiy muhit juda tarang.
cards.uzDef: Muayyan vaqtdagi hukmron siyosiy kayfiyat.
